name: Deflector
author: voodoo573
description: Feat from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. Your lightning reflexes make you hard to hit. You may expend your reaction to increase your AC by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus against an attack targeting you in melee. This feat can only be used while holding a finesse weapon that you're proficient with.
summary: Reaction: add your proficiency bonus to AC against a melee attack while holding a finesse weapon.
